name: Green Metro-Campus Zurich West / Campus ZRH1 (Lupfig)
notes: Green's main Swiss campus at Industriestrasse 33, Lupfig (Aargau), one of Switzerland's most important data locations; multiple operational datacenters plus new Datacenter 4 build (~CHF 70m, per NZZ/persoenlich) on Campus ZRH1; directory lists 40 MW for the campus (C-grade capacity, treat as lead). Green is Swiss colocation market leader (ISG study) with hyperscale customers incl. Google/Amazon (workzeitung 2026). Official page A for existence; B for capacity unless datasheet confirms.

name: Swisscom Rechenzentrum Bern-Wankdorf
notes: Swisscom flagship Tier IV datacenter at Bern-Wankdorf business park, opened ~2014 (2-year build, ~CHF 60-100m, capacity for 5,000 servers / 10,000 customer systems, rain-water cooling and flywheels); Swisscom colocation (Telehousing metro) is offered at 8 Swiss sites including Bern (2). Telecom/enterprise facility with colocation offering. Grade A for existence per operator pages; B for capacity/status details from trade press.

name: T-Systems / T Cloud Public Zollikofen (Bern)
notes: T Cloud Public Switzerland community cloud operated from sites in Bern and Zollikofen since 2022 (de.wikipedia entry citing T-Systems); T-Systems Schweiz AG registered in Zollikofen; datacentermap lists T-Systems Zollikofen facility. Public/enterprise cloud facility; capacity not published. Grade B (Wikipedia/methodology corroboration + directory) pending T-Systems official facility datasheet.

name: NorthC Datacenter Biel/Bienne
notes: NorthC operates three Swiss datacenters: two in Muenchenstein (Basel-Landschaft) and one in Biel (Bern canton), acquired via NTS Workspace/Netrics; offers colocation, hybrid multi-cloud and connectivity (HKBB member page, local press). Biel facility operational; capacity not published.

name: NorthC Datacenter Muenchenstein (Basel) 1 & 2
notes: Two colocation datacenters in Muenchenstein (BL) at Weidenstrasse 41: Muenchenstein 1 with 6 MW installed electrical power, 2N UPS, N+1 generator redundancy, high-density 22 kW racks; Muenchenstein 2 also operational; 2025-2026 AI/HPC-capable infrastructure upgrade at site 1 with Legrand; new 6-MW build reported by datacenter-insider. Official pages A for existence; capacity B (datasheet/partner sources).

name: ColoBale AG Colocation Datacenter (Basel region)
notes: Colocation datacenter serving the Basel region (company official page; management named: Julien Babelay sales, Stefan Mayer Geschäftsführer). Official company page confirms colocation offering; exact address/rack capacity not published on the page reviewed - C grade pending facility datasheet or permit record.

name: Swisscom Telehousing metro Basel
notes: Swisscom lists Basel among its eight Swiss datacenter/colocation locations (Telehousing metro shared rackroom / private room). Telecom carrier facility; capacity not published. Existence A per operator page; details B.

name: Equinix Geneva IBX (GV1 / GV2)
notes: Equinix operates five Swiss IBX data centers, two in Geneva: GV1 (Rue de la Confederation 6, Geneva city) and GV2 (Route du Bois-des-Freres 48, Le Lignon); approx. 4,400+ sqm colocation space across the metro; Exoscale hosts Swiss workloads here. Official page A for existence/location; ~1 MW (GV1) per directory C.

name: Safe Host / STACK Data Centre Plan-les-Ouates
notes: Safe Host (Romandy operator, associated with STACK Infrastructure) operates a hosting data centre in Plan-les-Ouates (Geneva); CADZIPLO project plans recovery of its low-temperature waste heat for the industrial zone district heating (ftige.ch); engineer reference confirms electrical project. Geneva metro also includes STACK GEN02/GEN03 campus. Grade A for existence per operator/partner pages; B for details.

name: ewl Rechenzentrum Stollen Luzern
developer: ewl energie wasser luzern (Rechenzentrum Stollen Luzern AG)
notes: Underground high-security datacenter in central Lucerne converted from a Cold War civil-defence shelter; operated by city utility ewl; cooled year-round via Vierwaldstaettersee lake-energy network; colocation market entry announced 2022 (Netzwoche). Official utility page A for existence; capacity not published.

name: achermann cloud services Datacenter Fluhgrund Luzern
notes: Enterprise managed-hosting datacenter 'Fluhgrund Luzern' operated by achermann cloud services; also offers TIER-3 infrastructure housing inside the ewl Stollen Luzern facility. Company factsheet C/B; small regional facility.
